summary: Yarrow Bioscience filed an 8-K on September 14, 2026, disclosing a September 10, 2026 underwriting agreement with Jefferies, TD Securities, and Guggenheim Securities as representatives. The company sold 5,769,231 common shares at a $26.00 public offering price, plus a fully exercised 30-day underwriter option for 865,384 additional shares. Gross proceeds total approximately 6,634,615 shares, with net proceeds estimated at $161.8 million after discounts and expenses. The shelf S-3 offering, closing September 14, 2026, includes 60-day officer and director lock-ups. This is a routine equity shelf takedown, not a special situation.
